d: A deadly fire has ripped through a confectionery factory in Serang, west of Jakarta, Indonesia, killing at least three people and leaving 36 others missing. The blaze engulfed the Fonusa Agung Mulia factory on November 21, with officials saying the building was already consumed by flames when firefighters arrived. Drone footage shows large sections of the factory destroyed, while the roof collapsed amid thick smoke. Rescue teams are combing through the rubble in search of missing victims. The cause of the fire remains under investigation.
